note: Enumerated observations, each naming its type, the money at stake and the evidence row ids so a reader can jump straight to them. Findings are not verdicts: they never assert a committed pair is wrong, and "committed_with_rivals" exists precisely to show where this view and the dashboard legitimately differ. Sorted by type priority, then by amount descending.

type_definitions.competing_candidates: One row carries two or more candidate edges. The matcher committed to at most one; the rest stay visible rather than being discarded.
type_definitions.committed_with_rivals: The matcher committed a pair while other candidates for the same row remained plausible. The clearest case where the relation view and the dashboard legitimately disagree — read both.
type_definitions.shell_amount_gap: Shell totals differ across sides and no attached pair explains the gap. Could be a split, a re-scope, or rows that belong elsewhere.
type_definitions.zero_overlap_attached: Measured spans share no overlap. Attached for scope review; the amount delta is withheld from adjustment totals.
type_definitions.cross_pap_twin: Identical row under different program sections on both sides, both left unmatched. Transfer or duplicate printing — unproven either way.
type_definitions.unsupplied_shell: One side of a shell is fully paired while the other still holds rows: split / insertion candidates, or dropped / re-titled items.
